ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous zones occupying the distal two-thirds of both lobes. Central region surrounding the peduncle and extending along the proximal trailing edge consists of solid low-intensity black. High-frequency black-on-white mottling observed at the transition boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 48 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring peaks with 5-15 pixel vertical amplitudes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward concave sweep along the leading edge margins terminating in sharp, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast yellowish-white circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated heavily at the terminal apex of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-pixel linear trajectories (rake marks) intersecting the high-intensity white zones; notable vertical parallel lines on the left lobe and diagonal intersecting lines on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive dark-pigmented rake mark scarring across white lobe surfaces and significant biological encrustation at both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique stippled transition zone between the black central region and white distal lobes characterized by high-density, low-diameter black pixel droplets.
